title: Inquiry
text: Tell me your date, your location, and what you have in mind. I reply within two days with availability.

title: Consultation
text: We look at references together, talk through what you want to wear and carry, and settle on a direction.

title: Design Planning
text: Your motifs are chosen and drawn out in advance, so the sitting is about the work rather than the decisions.

title: Your Mehndi Experience
text: The day itself, unhurried, with everything prepared before you arrive.
